proposals.spec_text: Background write failure must clean up dispatch map entry and release read reference
proposals.actual_behavior: Error path returns without cleanup, leaking entry and reference
proposals.proposed_change: Add release_read(key) and remove(key) calls in process_write_job error path
proposals.rationale: Resource leak bug — failed writes permanently consume dispatch map capacity

proposals.spec_text: Validate all receptacles are connected at initialize() time
proposals.actual_behavior: Only dispatch_map validated at init; gpu_services checked lazily
proposals.proposed_change: Either add gpu_services validation to init, or update spec for lazy validation of optional receptacles
proposals.rationale: Depends on whether GPU-less testing scenarios are needed

proposals.spec_text: Pass a unique PCI-derived identifier to each extent manager
proposals.actual_behavior: Passes data_disk_size instead of PCI-derived unique ID
proposals.proposed_change: Either pass PCI address as unique ID, or update spec to accept size-based identification
proposals.rationale: Depends on whether unique ID is needed for crash recovery across drives

proposals.proposed_change: Add FR-020 specifying two-phase store protocol for zero-copy writes
proposals.rationale: Critical performance API for large entries — avoids intermediate copy

proposals.proposed_change: Add FR-021 specifying LRU eviction with configurable watermarks
proposals.rationale: Essential for bounded-memory operation in production

proposals.feature: format_on_init config flag and version enums
proposals.proposed_change: Add FR-022 specifying format_on_init for first-run vs restart scenarios
proposals.rationale: Required operational parameter distinguishing fresh format from recovery
